title: Formalizing the Reduced Mahler 3/2 Dynamical System in Lean 4: Exact 1D Slack Reduction, Constructive Coasting Survivors, Conditional Finiteness Theorems, and Certified Transcendence Barriers
description: A 114-module, sorry-free Lean 4.19.0 + Mathlib v4.19.0 formalization of the reduced Mahler 3/2 dynamical system (Z-numbers), developed by Joshua Coon with Astra and Argon AI assistance. Proves the exact 1D minSlack dynamical reduction, converse companion reconstruction, conditional finiteness theorems, the 113-step survival and 114-step death of the 55-bit record-holder seed 29871555608238677, and 18 certified transcendence and Diophantine barriers.
